message:
All tests pass now (2/2). Nothing is committed.

The failure was a wrong expected value in the test, not a bug in the code. The test asserted `withVat(250) === 301`, but 250p plus 20% VAT is exactly 300p. `src/vat.js` already returns 300, and I confirmed the floating-point arithmetic rounds to 300.

I changed the one assertion in `test/vat.test.js` from 301 to 300 and left `src/vat.js` alone. Changing the code to hit 301 would have broken correct rounding.

claims.sentence: I changed the one assertion in `test/vat.test.js` from 301 to 300 and left `src/vat.js` alone.
